new_findings.title: Describe-run parse tests omit the newly required idempotency key
new_findings.defect: This file calls submitBulkDescribeRun([101]) at lines 102, 129, 142, 154, and 160, but describeApi.ts:1445 declares idempotencyKey as a required second argument. tsconfig.type-check.json includes js/**/*.ts, so npm run typecheck reports TS2554 for these calls; the first network expectation at line 104 also asserts the obsolete body without idempotency_key.
new_findings.failure_scenario: Running the package typecheck fails on the five calls because submitBulkDescribeRun now requires two arguments, blocking the TypeScript verification gate before merge.
new_findings.fix: Pass valid idempotency keys at each submitBulkDescribeRun test call and update the first expected request body to include its key.

summary: Both supplied findings hold, and their tests cover the corrections. One medium pre-merge issue remains: five parse-test calls omit the required idempotency key and are included in typecheck. The manifest-overlap test passed (26); Vitest and typecheck were not run in this sandbox.
